description: A KernelSU-based root solution for Android: kernel-level su with whitelist policies, an overlayfs module system, the built-in FolkZygisk engine, Sui (Shizuku API), SUSFS-based kernel hiding, and a fully themable Material 3 manager with an online theme store. Installs via LKM, patched boot image, or AnyKernel3.

latest_release.name: FinaSU v1.6.5
latest_release.body:
FinaSU v1.6.5 updates the built-in NoMount engine to v2.3.1 and protocol v23, with a refined SUSFS page switcher.

## English

### NoMount

- Updated the bundled NoMount kernel driver to upstream v2.3.1 and protocol v23 across the supported KMI matrix.
- Rule and UID listings now follow the protocol v23 opaque cursor, including multi-page results.
- Added validation for cursor progress, malformed UID payloads, and the all-ones list completion marker.
- ksud now requires protocol v23 and rejects older v22 drivers as incompatible.

### Manager

- Replaced the SUSFS page pill row with a horizontally scrollable tab row.
- Updated NoMount labels and documentation for v2.3.1.

## 简体中文

### NoMount

- 将内置 NoMount 内核驱动更新到上游 v2.3.1 和协议 v23，并覆盖受支持的 KMI 矩阵。
- 规则和 UID 列表改用协议 v23 的不透明游标分页，支持跨多页读取。
- 增加游标进度、UID 载荷格式和全 1 完成标记的校验。
- ksud 现在要求协议 v23，并将旧版 v22 驱动标记为不兼容。

### 管理器

- 将 SUSFS 页面切换器改为可横向滚动的标签栏。
- 更新 NoMount v2.3.1 的版本显示与文档。

detail.readme:
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LyraVoid/FinaSU?label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FinaSU/releases/latest) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-FinaSU-blue?logo=telegram)](https://t.me/FinaSU) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LyraVoid/FinaSU?logo=gnu)](/LICENSE)
**Language:** [English](./README.md) / [中文](./README_CN.md) FinaSU is a kernel-based root solution for Android, built on [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU). It combines kernel-level `su` and root access management with a module system, a built-in Zygisk engine, SUSFS support, and a configurable modern manager. --- ## Overview FinaSU provides: - Kernel-based `su` with whitelist-based root access management - A Magisk-like module system based on overlayfs and metamodules - App Profile, to confine root power to a per-app policy - The built-in FolkZygisk engine, with manager controls - The built-in Sui extension, which serves the Shizuku API to supported apps - SUSFS support, gated by kernel capability - Compile-time syscall hook selection: Tracepoint by default, or SUSFS Inline for ARM64 Built-In kernels - Kernel-level hiding: mount hiding, SELinux hiding, AVC log spoofing, and unmount policy - `.fpt` themes with FolkPatch-compatible exchange, plus an online theme store - Multi-page wallpapers, custom fonts, and a launcher icon switcher - Module repository browsing and one-tap installation - An in-app language picker with community translations ## Requirements - An ARM64 (arm64-v8a) Android device; `x86_64` and `riscv64` hooks are also present - A GKI kernel (5.10+) is recommended; 4.14+ is supported but requires building the kernel manually - Installation via LKM (a loadable `kernelsu.ko`), a patched boot image, or an AnyKernel3 package ## Manager - Multiple home layouts, including GridUI and dashboard-style pages - Configurable theming: colors, wallpapers, and fonts - A category-based settings hub covering general, appearance, behavior, function, security, and multimedia options - Optional update checks and boot-time module blocking ## Modules and Extensions ### KernelSU modules Standard KernelSU modules are managed from the manager. A single active metamodule can provide the mount backend, and FinaSU warns when an enabled metamodule may not be compatible with the built-in engine. ### FolkZygisk FolkZygisk is a built-in Zygisk engine. The manager exposes its installation and activation controls, and `ksud` steps the built-in engine aside whenever an external Zygisk provider is active, so provider modules install normally. ### Sui Sui is the built-in Shizuku API backend, for the apps that talk to Shizuku: they reach this extension instead of a separate Shizuku installation. The payload is built by this repository and embedded in ksud, so installation, enable and disable, and repair belong to FinaSU rather than to Sui's own installer, and `ksud` supervises the injected root and shell servers. The manager hosts the whole interface: the per-app Shizuku permission list, the default permission, the apps hidden from Sui, diagnostics, and the prompt for a real permission request, which is answered over the management channel. Sui's own management UI is not shipped. ### SUSFS SUSFS management is capability-gated. The controls appear only on kernels that support it, and every configuration change is applied with a receipt. `CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS` enables the SUSFS feature layer; it is separate from the syscall hook backend. Source-integrated ARM64 kernels can select the direct SUSFS Inline backend at build time, while LKM releases continue to use Tracepoint. The selected backend is reported by the kernel ABI and cannot be switched in the Manager. ### Folk-Mount Folk-Mount is the built-in module mount engine. It can run in auto, built-in, or metamodule mode. ### NoMount NoMount is the built-in VFS redirection backend: instead of mounting anything it takes over path resolution and directory iteration in a kernel module, so `/proc/mounts` stays clean. The module ships inside ksud (embedded per KMI, built by this repository); the backend needs neither a metamodule nor the `nm` binary. The manager exposes the driver state, the number of active rules, visibility exclusions and a "mounting off" mode; the backend can be set to automatic, built-in Folk Mount, metamodule only, NoMount or off. Mounting stays on the default `automatic` mode, so NoMount is only entered when it is selected. Choosing NoMount falls back to the built-in engine when the driver is unavailable and says so on the settings page. ksud also records each risky step before it runs: if a NoMount (or metamodule) injection never reached boot completion, the next boot skips that provider and mounts with the built-in engine instead, and the reason lands in `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount.log` — the same bounded, rotated log that records how many rules each boot injected and which directories they landed in, which is what a bug report needs to tell whether an injection touched a boot-critical path. To find out what a stuck boot was waiting for, arm `ksud mount capture on` first (150s after a boot that never finishes, or `ksud mount capture on 60`; `off` disarms): the capture lands in `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount_capture.log` with the blocked-task stacks from `sysrq w`, the end of the kernel log, the D-state tasks and pstore. Visibility is an exception list kept by ksud: every app sees the injected files until it is added, and the NoMount page copies each app profile's "unmount modules" verdict into that list on demand, so later profile changes need another copy. Directory symlinks are traversed as directories and merged file by file, with cycle detection and per-module path deduplication. A `.replace` marker or opaque directory defaults to file merging; only the explicitly allowlisted `/product/fonts` target may become a directory redirect, and only when its stock target is absent or empty. Partition roots and directories named `lib64`, `lib`, `bin` or `etc` are never directory-replaced. Downgrades are logged, `mount.log` includes `dir_replace=N`, and `ksud nomount inject --dry-run --verbose` labels file redirects and directory replacements separately. The built-in NoMount provider also starts a detached UI-readiness observer (180 seconds by default). It requires `sys.boot_completed=1`, a running SurfaceFlinger and a stopped boot animation, not just the boot-completed callback. An observation that runs and does not confirm readiness leaves a persistent marker, so the next boot uses the built-in mount engine and records a warning; one that never ran—the device rebooted before the deadline, or the helper died—is treated as inconclusive, is dropped, and NoMount keeps running. These signals do not guarantee a working display, and this is not an in-kernel loader timeout. Set `/data/adb/ksu/mount_ui_guard` to `delay=300` to change the observation deadline (30–900 seconds), or `off` to stop arming new observations. A confirmed-failure marker clears itself once a boot with the built-in engine mounts successfully, so keep the `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount.log` from the failed boot before retrying. ## Security The manager authenticates itself by APK signature: only the trusted manager and apps the user has explicitly claimed can manage the kernel. Root access is whitelist-based, so only granted apps can reach `su`. See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reporting. ## Translation English and Chinese are the reference languages. Only submit corrections for the target language, and include the entire translated file when adding a new language. ## Download and Installation 1. Download the latest package from the [Releases page](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FinaSU/releases/latest). 2. Install the manager on the device. 3. Follow the in-app flow to install the kernel module, patch a boot image, or flash an AnyKernel3 package. ## Building from Source The repository ships a local mirror of the CI pipeline: ```bash ./build.sh ksud # build the Rust userspace daemon ./build.sh lkm # build the kernel module ./build.sh apk # build the manager APK (requires the ksud build) ./build.sh all # full local run ``` See [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for the per-component build and check commands. ## Credits - [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU) - upstream project - [ReZygisk](https://github.com/PerformanC/ReZygisk) - FolkZygisk is adapted from it - [YukiSU](https://github.com/Anatdx/YukiSU) - dynamic manager reference - [BakaSU](https://github.com/Baka-SU/BakaSU) - AnyKernel3 flashing and smaller-feature reference - [Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk) - `magiskpolicy` and module concepts - [SUSFS](https://gitlab.com/simonpunk/susfs4ksu) - kernel-level hiding - [Sui](https://github.com/XiaoTong6666/Sui) - the built-in Shizuku API backend - [Shizuku-API](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku-API) - the Shizuku client API library - [FolkPatch](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FolkPatch) - theme format and design reference - [MMRL](https://github.com/MMRLApp/MMRL) - module repository format reference ## License - Files under the `kernel` directory are [GPL-2.0-only](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.en.html). - All other parts are [GPL-3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html). ## Community - Telegram: [@FinaSU](https://t.me/FinaSU)
detail.readme_zh:
[![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/LyraVoid/FinaSU?label=Release&logo=github)](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FinaSU/releases/latest) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-FinaSU-blue?logo=telegram)](https://t.me/FinaSU) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LyraVoid/FinaSU?logo=gnu)](/LICENSE)
**语言：** [English](./README.md) / [中文](./README_CN.md) FinaSU 是基于 [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU) 构建的 Android 内核级 Root 方案，集成了内核 `su` 与 Root 权限管理、模块系统、内置 Zygisk 引擎、SUSFS 支持以及可配置的现代化管理器。 --- ## 功能概览 FinaSU 提供： - 内核级 `su` 与基于白名单的 Root 权限管理 - 基于 overlayfs 与 metamodule 的类 Magisk 模块系统 - App Profile，将 Root 权限限制在单个应用策略内 - 内置 FolkZygisk 引擎，并提供管理器控制 - 内置 Sui 扩展，为支持的应用提供 Shizuku API - SUSFS 支持，按内核能力开关 - 编译期 syscall Hook 选择：默认 Tracepoint，ARM64 Built-In 内核可选择 SUSFS Inline - 内核级隐藏：挂载隐藏、SELinux 隐藏、AVC 日志伪装与卸载策略 - `.fpt` 主题，与 FolkPatch 互通，并提供在线主题商店 - 多页壁纸、自定义字体与启动图标切换 - 模块仓库浏览与一键安装 - 应用内语言切换与社区翻译 ## 前置要求 - ARM64（arm64-v8a）Android 设备；同时保留 `x86_64` 与 `riscv64` 钩子 - 推荐 GKI 内核（5.10+）；4.14+ 受支持，但需要自行编译内核 - 通过 LKM（可加载的 `kernelsu.ko`）、修补 boot 镜像或 AnyKernel3 包进行安装 ## 管理器 - 多种首页布局，包括 GridUI 与仪表盘式页面 - 可配置的主题：配色、壁纸与字体 - 分类式设置中心，涵盖通用、外观、行为、功能、安全与多媒体 - 可选更新检查与开机模块屏蔽 ## 模块与扩展 ### KernelSU 模块 标准 KernelSU 模块由管理器管理。同一时间只允许一个 metamodule 提供挂载后端；当已启用的 metamodule 与内置引擎不兼容时，FinaSU 会给出提示。 ### FolkZygisk FolkZygisk 是内置的 Zygisk 引擎。管理器提供安装与激活控制；已有外置 Zygisk provider 时 `ksud` 会让内置引擎自动让位，因此 provider 模块可正常安装。 ### Sui Sui 是内置的 Shizuku API 后端：使用 Shizuku 的应用直接走该扩展，无需另装 Shizuku。载荷由本仓库构建并内置于 ksud，因此安装、启停与修复都由 FinaSU 负责，不走 Sui 自带安装器；注入的 root 与 shell 服务由 `ksud` 监管。 界面完全由管理器提供：逐应用的 Shizuku 权限列表、默认权限、对 Sui 隐藏的应用、诊断信息，以及真实请求的授权弹窗——请求经管理通道回传。上游 Sui 自带的界面不再随包提供。 ### SUSFS SUSFS 管理按能力开关。仅在支持的内核上显示相关控件，每次配置变更都会附带应用回执。`CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS` 只启用 SUSFS 功能层，与 syscall Hook 后端相互独立；源码集成的 ARM64 内核可以在编译期选择直接入口的 SUSFS Inline，LKM 发布包继续使用 Tracepoint。管理器只通过内核 ABI 读取后端，不能在运行时切换。 ### Folk-Mount Folk-Mount 是内置的模块挂载引擎，可在自动、内置或 metamodule 模式间切换。 ### NoMount NoMount 是内建的 VFS 路径重定向后端：不产生任何挂载，而是由内核模块直接接管路径解析与目录遍历，因此不会污染 `/proc/mounts`。内核模块随 ksud 一起分发（按 KMI 内嵌，由本仓库自行编译），后端本身不依赖模块或 `nm` 二进制。 管理器提供驱动状态、注入规则数、可见性例外与「关闭挂载」；挂载模式可选 `自动 / 内建 Folk Mount / 仅 metamodule / NoMount / 关闭`，默认是 `自动`，只有显式选择才会进入 NoMount。选择 NoMount 时若驱动不可用会自动回退到内建引擎，并在设置页说明原因。ksud 还会在装载与注入之前先落一份「进行中」记录：如果某次 NoMount（或 metamodule）注入之后没能走完启动，下次开机会跳过它、改用内建引擎把模块挂上，并把原因写进 `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount.log`；同一份日志（有体积上限、会自动轮转）也会记下每次注入的规则数与命中的顶层目录，方便从 bug 报告里判断注入到底碰了哪些路径。要查"卡住时内核在等什么"，可以先 `ksud mount capture on`（默认卡过 150 秒就取证，`ksud mount capture on 60` 可以改时长，`off` 关掉）：取证结果同样落在 `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount_capture.log`，包含 `sysrq w` 打印的全部阻塞任务栈、内核日志结尾、D 状态任务与 pstore。可见性是一份由 ksud 保存的例外名单：名单内的应用看到原厂文件系统，其余应用都能看到注入的文件；NoMount 页可以按需把各应用 Profile 的「卸载模块」判定复制进这份名单，改动 Profile 后需要再复制一次。 目录型符号链接会被当作目录递归遍历并**逐文件合并**（带环路检测与按模块去重）；`.replace` 标记或 opaque 目录同样默认降级为逐文件合并，只有白名单里的 `/product/fonts`、且其原目录不存在或为空时才允许整目录替换。分区根目录，以及名为 `lib64`、`lib`、`bin`、`etc` 的目录，**永远不会**被整目录替换。降级会写进日志：`mount.log` 里带 `dir_replace=N`，`ksud nomount inject --dry-run --verbose` 也会分别标注文件重定向与目录替换。 内建 NoMount 还会启动一个独立的 UI 就绪观察者（默认 180 秒）：它要求 `sys.boot_completed=1`、SurfaceFlinger 正在运行、开机动画已结束，而不只是收到 boot-completed 回调。**观察跑完但没能确认**时会留下一个持久标记，下一次开机会改用内建挂载引擎并记录一条 warning；如果观察**根本没来得及跑**（设备在时限内就重启，或助手进程被结束），则判为「不确定」，标记会被丢弃、NoMount 照常启用。这些信号不保证显示真的可用，它也不是内核装载器的超时。把 `/data/adb/ksu/mount_ui_guard` 写成 `delay=300` 可以改观察时长（30–900 秒），写 `off` 则停止新的观察；「已确认失败」的标记会在下一次用内建引擎成功挂载后自动清除，所以重试之前请先把那次失败开机的 `/data/adb/ksu/log/mount.log` 取走。 ## 安全提示 管理器通过 APK 签名验证自身身份：只有受信任的管理器以及用户显式认领的应用才能管理内核。Root 权限基于白名单，只有被授权的应用才能访问 `su`。漏洞上报请参阅 [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)。 ## 翻译 英语和中文是参考语言。翻译修正请只提交对应语言的文件；新增语言时，请在 Pull Request 中提供完整翻译文件。 ## 下载与安装 1. 从[发布页面](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FinaSU/releases/latest)下载最新安装包。 2. 在设备上安装管理器。 3. 按应用内引导安装内核模块、修补 boot 镜像，或刷入 AnyKernel3 包。 ## 从源码构建 仓库提供了与 CI 一致的本地构建入口： ```bash ./build.sh ksud # 构建 Rust 用户态守护进程 ./build.sh lkm # 构建内核模块 ./build.sh apk # 构建管理器 APK（需先构建 ksud） ./build.sh all # 完整本地构建 ``` 各组件具体的构建与检查命令请参阅 [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md)。 ## 开源致谢 - [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU)：上游项目 - [ReZygisk](https://github.com/PerformanC/ReZygisk)：FolkZygisk 由其改写而来 - [YukiSU](https://github.com/Anatdx/YukiSU)：动态管理器参考 - [BakaSU](https://github.com/Baka-SU/BakaSU)：AnyKernel3 刷写及部分小功能参考 - [Magisk](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk)：`magiskpolicy` 与模块概念 - [SUSFS](https://gitlab.com/simonpunk/susfs4ksu)：内核级隐藏 - [Sui](https://github.com/XiaoTong6666/Sui)：内置 Shizuku API 后端实现 - [Shizuku-API](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku-API)：扩展实现的 Shizuku 客户端 API 库 - [FolkPatch](https://github.com/LyraVoid/FolkPatch)：主题格式与设计参考 - [MMRL](https://github.com/MMRLApp/MMRL)：模块仓库格式参考 ## 许可证 - `kernel` 目录下的文件遵循 [GPL-2.0-only](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.en.html)。 - 其余部分遵循 [GPL-3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html)。 ## 社区 - Telegram：[**@FinaSU**](https://t.me/FinaSU)
